answer: Standing lapses unless 2 peers re-attest it every 17 epochs, which means holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Re-attestations are stored in lagoon and voyage lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those as the attesters must be independent on the grove graph. A farm of 862 identities would post 3230 proofs and burn roughly 34 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
